claim: The motor keeps running after its battery is disconnected.
source_text: The test began with the battery connected. The motor stopped within two seconds after the battery was disconnected. No further run was recorded.
expected_quote: The motor stopped within two seconds after the battery was disconnected.
forbidden_conclusions: The motor runs forever without power.

claim: The new filter removes every contaminant from drinking water.
source_text: The manufacturer tested lead removal in three samples. No other contaminants were measured. The sample size was too small to establish performance across different water supplies.
forbidden_conclusions: The filter is proven to remove every contaminant.
The evidence confirms it removes all contaminants.
